recommendation: Keep the source fix. It restores FHIR-42989 semantics on both current authoritative checklist surfaces without broad cleanup of unrelated safety checklist drift.
issue_request: FHIR-42989 was an Applied FHIR-core FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking the Clinical Safety checklist to clarify modifier-element handling, clarify modifierExtension handling, and add a Resource.implicitRules safety check for every processed resource.
initial_application: Commit 413371928177b066069986c67e933d242b8234d0 applied the approved safety.html and safety-entries CodeSystem language, but the current active CodeSystem no longer contained those changes. Commit e963b596c7ad3585b2285ac64ae7f8ee16a644ac later added only a shorter implicitRules item to safety.html, leaving the modifier/modifierExtension language stale and the CodeSystem unsynchronized.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists safety.html as a current page, and source/fhir.ini actively includes source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml as safety-entries. The safety page advertises that CodeSystem as the formal checklist reference surface. FHIR-I minutes from 2023-10-23 explain the implicitRules origin, and minutes from 2024-04-08 confirm the final approved modifier, modifierExtension, and implicitRules checklist scope. Zulip searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/safety.html to use the approved modifier, modifierExtension, and Resource.implicitRules checklist wording; normalized the implicitRules checklist code/title to implicit-rules; and added the matching implicit-rules concept plus updated definitions to source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml.
source_changes: source/safety.html: clarified modifier and modifierExtension checklist entries and replaced the shorter implicitRules item with the approved Resource.implicitRules behavior check.
source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml: added the implicit-rules concept and synchronized the modifiers and modifier-extensions definitions with the safety checklist.

related_jiras.note: Filed from the same 2023-10-23 rendering-styleSensitive/implicitRules discussion, but it concerns extension behavior rather than this safety checklist source change.
